usage: arb-engine live [-h] [--sport {nfl,ncaaf,nba,nhl}] [--every EVERY] [--hours HOURS]
                       [--iterations ITERATIONS] [--once] [--pre-hours PRE_HOURS]
                       [--steal-edge STEAL_EDGE] [--target-margin TARGET_MARGIN] [--venues VENUES]
                       [--contracts CONTRACTS] [--gold] [--record [DB]] [--bankroll BANKROLL]
                       [--kelly KELLY] [--journal JOURNAL] [--fast SECONDS]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --sport {nfl,ncaaf,nba,nhl}
  --every EVERY         seconds between ticks
  --hours HOURS
  --iterations ITERATIONS
  --once
  --pre-hours PRE_HOURS
                        also show games starting within this many hours
  --steal-edge STEAL_EDGE
  --target-margin TARGET_MARGIN
  --venues VENUES
  --contracts CONTRACTS
  --gold
  --record [DB]         append every game tick to this SQLite file (bare flag: out/history.db)
  --bankroll BANKROLL   dollars to deploy; STEAL alerts then include a contract count (fractional
                        Kelly, capped by depth)
  --kelly KELLY
  --journal JOURNAL
  --fast SECONDS        between full ticks, refresh Kalshi + Robinhood top of book for the live
                        games every SECONDS (e.g. 1) and run the LAG / ARB signals on it
